description: Source code for plugin management in a software project, including functions to load and free plugins, handle JSON plugins, and manage dynamic objects and vendor extensions.

methods.name: load_dotso_plugin
methods.description: Loads a dynamic shared object plugin, initializes memory, and retrieves plugin symbols.

methods.name: free_dotso_plugin
methods.description: Unloads a plugin and cleans up associated memory.

methods.name: load_json_plugin
methods.description: Loads a JSON-based plugin configuration, parses JSON, and initializes plugin objects.

methods.name: free_json_plugin
methods.description: Frees resources associated with JSON plugins.
